_note: Furniture catalogue for the Cultural Furniture Recommendation + Placement feature. Lives next to ontology.json because both the backend (recommendation ranking + placement scoring) and the frontend (furniture cards) read it. v1 ships floor-standing items only — rugs, cushions, wall art and mirrors are deferred because each needs a different geometry solution (floor-plane warping, seat-surface detection, wall-plane estimation) rather than simple depth-scaled compositing.
_units: real_width_cm / real_height_cm / real_depth_cm are approximate real-world dimensions, used to scale the asset against the depth map at the candidate position. floor_footprint_cm is the width x depth rectangle the item occupies on the floor plane.
_asset_pipeline: Assets are generated by scripts/generate_furniture_assets.py using each culture's own trained LoRA, then background-removed to transparent PNG. Self-generated => licensing is ours, unlike scraped stock imagery.

placement_types.floor_standing: Bottom edge must contact the detected floor plane. Scaled by depth at the contact point.
placement_types.floor_flat: Lies flat on the floor plane; needs perspective warp, not just scaling. DEFERRED in v1.
placement_types.wall_mounted: Must lie inside a visible wall region and follow the wall plane. DEFERRED in v1.
placement_types.on_surface: Sits on top of existing furniture; requires seat/table surface detection. DEFERRED in v1.

zones.corner: Where two wall planes meet the floor — favours tall/vertical items.
zones.against_wall: Floor area adjacent to a wall plane — favours sofas, cabinets.
zones.open_floor: Unoccupied floor away from walls — favours tables, poufs.
zones.beside_seating: Floor adjacent to a detected sofa/chair — favours side tables, lamps.
